title: tillaea moschata
intro: Tillaea moschata, commonly known as "Fragrant Tillaea" or "Muskroot", is a flowering plant species in the family Cactaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from anxiety, stress, and insomnia due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tillaea moschata include sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects, which contribute to its calming and pain-relieving properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
